newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash, buy stops.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash, buy stops.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on firm cash markets. Buy stops were hit in late dealings which drove the market to session highs near the close, traders said.
"There was no sizable buying but we're still hearing the cash markets are above futures," a trader said.
Traders said Dean Witter Reynolds was a light but steady buyer on the day and the buy-stops were hit in the January at $10.35 per cwt. The session high for January was $10.39.
Rice futures closed two to 10 cents higher, with November up 10 at $10.30 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 250 contracts, below the 646 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at 30 contracts, well below the 148 traded Tuesday.
